name: roll_move
description: Roll a move for a player character: 2d6 plus the trait the move uses, plus any condition penalty. For a move that rolls +one of your traits, or Get What You Seek, give the trait as stat. Add a modifier for things the story gives, such as +1 to help or hinder a Friend or a Rival, or -1 from Hexed. Pass the result to the player and narrate the band it lands in.

character.description: The name of the player character who rolls.

modifier.description: A situational modifier from the story, such as +1 for a Friend or -1 for Hexed. Use 0 when none applies.

stat.description: The trait to roll with, for a move that does not name one.

name: adjust_counter
description: Change a player character's Luck or Experience: mark a point of Luck when they spend it, regain Luck at the end of a school year, or mark Experience. Use a negative change to spend or clear a point and a positive one to add or regain it.

character.description: The name of the player character.

change.description: How much to add (positive) or remove (negative).

name: take_advancement
description: Spend one of a player character's Advancements on an option: raise a trait, add a Favourite Subject, learn a spell, gain a magical object, or regain Luck. Use stat for an option that names a trait.

character.description: The name of the player character.

stat.description: The trait to raise, for an option that takes one.

name: end_period
description: End a stretch of play, such as a school year, for every player character at once. Call it when the school year completes; it applies that period's effects to each character.

name: adjust_tally
description: Add points to, or deduct points from, a running tally such as a House's points. Use a negative change to deduct.

entry.description: Which entry of the tally, such as a House.

change.description: How many points to add (positive) or deduct (negative).

reason.description: Why the points change, such as a Quidditch win.

name: set_relation
description: Make someone a player character's Friend or Rival, or end that relation. Use it only at the end of a session, as the rules require.

character.description: The name of the player character.

other.description: The name of the person, player or non-player, they are linked to.

added.description: true to make them this relation, false to end it.
